**Risk officer verdict: REFUSE. Do not buy at any size.**

The brief shows a FACTORY-class coin, which our base rates put at about 46% loss per trade. The curve data reinforces that: bundle_share and top3_share are both 1.0, top-5 buyers hold 98.9% of early buys, and a launch bot was present. Those are classic bundled-supply signatures, not organic demand.

The 30-minute +79% return and 341 buyers in the last 15 minutes don't rescue it. Sell-to-buy in the first two minutes was 0.0004, meaning almost nothing sold, so holders can't exit cleanly once the bundle decides to rotate. The 0% drawdown from the 30-minute high is also a warning, not a comfort: a bundled coin that hasn't dipped yet has the most to give back.

If the desk ever revisits this coin, the conditions would be a bundle share well below 1.0, a top-5 buyer share that falls materially, and a real drawdown with sustained sell pressure absorbed. None of that is present now. Skipping costs nothing.

The brief's own labels cut against this buy. The class is FACTORY, which has lost about 46% on average, and the curve shows bundle_share 1.0, top3_share 1.0, and a 2.87 completer share, meaning the early supply was taken in one coordinated bundle. Within the first two minutes after graduation, 15 outside buyers took 151 SOL while the top five buyers account for 98.9% of volume and the sell-to-buy ratio is 0.0004, so almost nothing has been sold back to the market. That pattern looks like a launch bot and a concentrated group that could exit at any point.

The honest case for demand is thin. The last 15 minutes show 341 buyers, 95 SOL bought and 56 SOL sold, with 263 sellers, so real two-way trading is happening and the coin is up 29% in that window and 79% over 30 minutes. A 0.0% drawdown from the 30-minute high means it has not yet been tested. But the 15-minute flow is still modest against a $682k market cap, and the early buying is so concentrated that the apparent demand may be the same few wallets rotating.

Verdict: no strong case to buy. Skip it.

That supply was likely accumulated by a few wallets and is sitting on a +79% 30-minute return. Bundled supply on a factory coin typically dumps together, and the 46% base-rate loss applies. Note the last 15 minutes already show 56.23 SOL sold against 95.03 bought, with 263 sellers, so distribution may have started. A dip from the 0% drawdown is the likely trigger. Skip.
